course.programmeTitle: Bachelor of Engineering in Data Science and Engineering
course.title: Final Project II
course.description: Final Project II is the culminating capstone experience in which students complete the full development, deployment, and evaluation of their data‑driven system initiated in Project I. Over 16 weeks, students refine and optimize machine learning models, integrate backend, frontend, and ML components, and build a functional end‑to‑end application. Emphasis is placed on modern engineering practices such as containerization, cloud deployment, API development, testing, logging, monitoring, and system scalability. Students conduct pilot testing with real users, incorporate feedback through iterative improvements, and assess ethical impacts related to fairness, privacy, and societal implications. The course concludes with a professional final defense and comprehensive report that demonstrates technical competence, ethical responsibility, teamwork, and communication skills necessary for real‑world data science and engineering practice.

topics.title: Topic 1: Review of Phase 1 & Planning Sprint
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Review and analyze the Phase I project outputs to identify improvement areas for implementation. LLO2: Develop a sprint plan outlining tasks, responsibilities, and timelines for Project II. LLO3: Coordinate team roles and expectations to prepare for the integration and deployment phases.

topics.title: Topic 2: Model Optimization, Hyperparameter Tuning, Feature Engineering
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Apply feature engineering techniques to improve model inputs. LLO2: Perform hyperparameter tuning using systematic search strategies. LLO3: Evaluate performance improvements between baseline and optimized models.

topics.title: Topic 2: Model Optimization, Hyperparameter Tuning, Feature Engineering
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Experiment with advanced optimization techniques (e.g., Bayesian search, ensemble improvements). LLO2: Analyze trade‑offs between performance, complexity, and computational cost. LLO3: Document optimization results with reproducible experiment logs.

topics.title: Topic 2: Model Optimization, Hyperparameter Tuning, Feature Engineering
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Compare multiple optimized models using appropriate evaluation metrics. LLO2: Select the best‑fit model for system integration based on evidence. LLO3: Present model‑related decisions and justifications to team members.

topics.title: Topic 3: System Integration (Backend + Frontend + ML Model)
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Integrate the ML model into backend services using appropriate interfaces or APIs. LLO2: Connect backend components with frontend elements to enable full data flow. LLO3: Conduct initial end‑to‑end integration tests to ensure system functionality.

topics.title: Topic 3: System Integration (Backend + Frontend + ML Model)
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Refine system architecture to improve modularity and maintainability. LLO2: Evaluate potential data sources for accessibility and suitability. LLO3: Construct a complete requirements specification document.

topics.title: Topic 4: Deployment (Cloud, Docker, APIs, Streamlit/FastAPI)
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Containerize the system using Docker or similar tools for consistent deployment. LLO2: Deploy the application to a cloud or local environment using appropriate deployment pipelines. LLO3: Configure APIs or endpoints for external access and system interaction.

topics.title: Topic 5: Testing, Logging & Monitoring
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Implement structured logging for traceability and failure diagnosis. LLO2: Configure monitoring tools or dashboards to track system behavior. LLO3: Perform systematic functional testing to validate system operations.

topics.title: Topic 5: Testing, Logging & Monitoring
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Conduct performance and load testing to assess system scalability. LLO2: Analyze monitoring data to identify errors, bottlenecks, or anomalies. LLO3: Apply refinements to address issues identified during testing and monitoring.

topics.title: Topic 6: Ethical Impact Assessment & Scalability
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Identify ethical risks related to bias, fairness, privacy, or unintended consequences. LLO2: Assess system scalability in terms of performance, infrastructure, and resource demands. LLO3: Propose mitigation strategies to address ethical and scalability concerns.

topics.title: Topic 6: Ethical Impact Assessment & Scalability
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Analyze user impact and societal implications of the deployed system. LLO2: Review ethical trade-offs in model and engineering decisions. LLO3: Develop a formal ethical impact report summarizing findings and recommendations.

topics.title: Topic 7: Pilot Testing with Users
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Design a pilot-testing protocol including user tasks and evaluation metrics. LLO2: Collect user feedback through structured observation or interviews. LLO3: Analyze pilot test data to derive insights for system improvement.

topics.title: Topic 7: Pilot Testing with Users
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Prioritize system improvements based on user feedback and pilot results. LLO2: Implement refinements to enhance system usability and reliability. LLO3: Validate updated system changes through rapid re-testing.

topics.title: Topic 8: Final Revision & Peer Review
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Conduct peer reviews of system features, documentation, and code quality. LLO2: Integrate peer feedback into the final version of the project. LLO3: Prepare polished materials (slides, scripts, demo flow) for final defense.

topics.title: Topic 8: Final Revision & Peer Review
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Finalize all project documentation including architecture, testing, and ethical reports. LLO2: Conduct internal team rehearsals for final defense sessions. LLO3: Produce the release candidate version of the project ready for submission and demo.

topics.title: Topic 9: Final Defense & Report Submission
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Deliver a professional final presentation demonstrating system functionality and project outcomes. LLO2: Defend technical and ethical decisions during Q&A with instructors and panelists. LLO3: Submit the final project report including full documentation, results, and reflections.

studentResponsibilitiesRaw: Read the learning materials beforehand which means to be ready for the next session. Be completely engaged in class, active, take notes, and ask questions in class. Students are required to participate in various activities in and out of the classroom, such as group work, and individual homework for assignments and reports assigned by the subject teacher. Submit the assigned tasks such as homework, assignments, or research proposal on time.
coursePolicyRaw: Students must abide by the following policies: Attendance & Preparation Students are expected to attend all classes (online/on-site). Assigned readings and preparation outlines must be completed before class if any. Active participation in group discussions and post-chapter evaluations is required. Academic Integrity All assignments, quizzes, and exams must be done individually. Academic misconduct includes: - Presenting others’ work as one’s own. - Engaging in plagiarism or cheating. Homework & Assignments Preparation outlines must be submitted on time; late submissions incur penalties. Peer discussion is encouraged, but midterm and final exams must be independent. Examinations Midterm and final exams are closed-book. Penalties Violations of academic integrity may result in a failing grade and referral to the Office of Student Affairs. Students uncertain about potential violations should consult the instructor in advance.
